title: ScrapeBench: Evaluating Legal Compliance of AI Agents in Website Scraping
abstract: arXiv:2611.11306v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: AI agents deployed on the open web are becoming more capable of performing actions that may breach contractual provisions and violate computer security laws. In this paper, we introduce ScrapeBench, the first agentic benchmark for empirically evaluating the legal compliance of AI agents with website scraping policies, namely terms of service (ToS) and $\texttt{robots.txt}$ directives. Across widely used closed-weight and open-weight AI agents, we find that most agents exhibit low compliance rates (< 5%) when instructed to scrape websites in our sample of 1,626 popular websites that explicitly prohibit scraping. In addition, we observe that even where AI agents actively check the applicable ToS and $\texttt{robots.txt}$, they continue to exhibit low compliance rates. Conversely, in our sample of 269 websites that do not prohibit scraping, we observe that agents sometimes refuse to scrape despite it being lawful, such as Claude O

translated_title: ScrapeBench：评估AI智能体在网站抓取中的法律合规性
translated_abstract: 部署在开放网络上的AI智能体越来越有能力执行可能违反合同条款和计算机安全法律的行为。在本文中，我们介绍了ScrapeBench，这是首个用于实证评估AI智能体在网站抓取策略（即服务条款ToS和robots.txt指令）方面法律合规性的智能体基准测试。在广泛使用的闭源权重与开源权重AI智能体中，我们发现，当被指示抓取我们样本中1,626个明确禁止抓取的热门网站时，大多数智能体表现出极低的合规率（<5%）。此外，我们观察到，即使AI智能体主动检查了适用的ToS和robots.txt，它们仍然表现出较低的合规率。相反，在我们样本中269个不禁止抓取的网站上，我们观察到智能体有时会拒绝抓取，尽管这样做是合法的，例如Claude O（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出首个评估AI智能体网站抓取法律合规性的基准ScrapeBench，发现大多数智能体在抓取明确禁止抓取的网站时合规率低于5%，即使主动检查了ToS和robots.txt也依然如此，而在允许抓取的网站上却有时会错误地拒绝抓取。
en_tdlr: ScrapeBench, the first agentic benchmark for evaluating AI agents' legal compliance with website scraping policies, reveals that most agents show less than 5% compliance when scraping sites that explicitly prohibit it—even after checking ToS and robots.txt—while sometimes wrongly refusing to scrape lawful sites.
